features.title: Start here
features.summary: Paper money, analysis credits and your first workflow.
features.body: Paper capital is simulated trading money. Analysis credits are separate and may pay for model analysis. Start with Limits, research a symbol, create a plan, check sizing, then deliberately confirm a paper ticket. Paper results do not prove live execution quality.

faqs.answer: No. Paper capital funds simulated positions in the ledger. Analysis credits are a separate balance for supported analysis runs.

features.title: Models & connections
features.summary: Choose models and connect a personal provider.
features.body: Add personal API keys in Model connections; keys are encrypted on the server. Select quick and deep providers in the analysis form. faqs.answer: Built-in guide search works without a key. Optional AI help requires a supported personal provider and your explicit opt-in. It does not use analysis credits.

features.title: Plans & exits
features.summary: Define entry, stop, target and exit time.
features.body: Create a draft plan from a symbol and entry, or from a triggered entry timer. Review the entry, stop rule, target rule and flat-by time. Save edits before sizing a ticket. A plan describes an intended trade; creating it does not place an order. An intraday replay needs an entry time, which may be absent for a manually created plan.

faqs.question: Why is Time Machine unavailable on my plan?
faqs.answer: Intraday replay needs the entry bar time and enough historical session windows. A manual plan without an entry time cannot run that intraday replay.

features.title: Time Machine
features.summary: Explore a plan using historical bars and simulated paths.
features.body: Time Machine compares a plan with historical outcomes and simulated paths. Intraday mode needs at least 20 complete prior session windows and the entry bar time. Swing mode uses daily bars and has different history requirements. Insufficient data is reported honestly. Simulated odds are not predictions and a stop is not a guarantee.

faqs.question: What does only 0 full sessions mean?
faqs.answer: No qualifying complete prior session windows were found for that symbol and date. Intraday Time Machine needs at least 20. Check symbol, date and history availability; do not interpret the missing result as a successful test.

features.title: Sizing & risk checks
features.summary: Size the trade within your configured limits.
features.body: Use the sizing and risk check control on a saved plan to create a reviewable ticket. Inspect quantity, per-share risk, total risk and failed checks. Limits include daily loss, per-trade risk, order value, trade count, concentration and required stops. A blocked ticket needs a corrected plan or deliberate limit review, not a bypass.

faqs.question: Does creating a ticket confirm a trade?
faqs.answer: No. Review the ticket and confirm it deliberately. The guide never confirms tickets or overrides failed risk checks.

features.title: Telegram & messages
features.summary: Get updates and approve paper proposals from Telegram.
features.body: Configure a Telegram bot, link your chat and verify the connection using the Messages screen. Enable desired updates and paper approvals. A paper proposal has Approve paper trade, Reject and Status controls plus a plan link. Approval is subject to expiry and fresh risk checks; it does not place a live broker order. WhatsApp is optional and requires separate setup.

faqs.question: Does Telegram approval buy shares in my broker account?
faqs.answer: No. Approve paper trade applies to a paper proposal. A valid approval creates the simulated trading workflow after risk checks; live broker orders are separate and explicitly guarded.
